generalfeedback.text: Gaps (interstices) are required so that grout can fill the crevices and lock all tesserae into a unified, sealed surface.

answer.text: To make the artwork lighter in weight

feedback.text: Incorrect. Gaps (interstices) are required so that grout can fill the crevices and lock all tesserae into a unified, sealed surface.

answer.text: To allow grout to penetrate and bond the pieces together securely
